verdict.rationale: Video dubbing and translation is a fair question for an AI video generation product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents native audio and dialogue generation for new clips (veo-docs-1, veo-docs-5), video inputs, and multi-turn element-replacement editing (veo-docs-9). Nothing documents translating an existing video into other languages while preserving the speaker's voice and lip sync, and these adjacent features earn no credit.
